company_name: Grace Haozan Applied Material Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides essential consumables for semiconductor substrate manufacturing, crucial for various semiconductor applications.
summary: Grace Haozan Applied Material Co., Ltd specializes in consumables for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on grinding, lapping, polishing, and wire cutting. They supply materials like Silicon Carbide and Aluminum Oxide powders, diamond powders, and polishing slurries used in the production of semiconductor substrates such as GaAs on Silicon, GaN, InP, SiGe, SOI, SOS, and Silicon Carbide.
capabilities: Polishing powders made from Silicon Carbide and Aluminum Oxide
Consumables for grinding, lapping, and wire cutting
Materials for compound semiconductor substrates and solar cell substrates
